title: Purple Rain
tagline: Before he created the music, he lived every bit of it.
about: A young Minneapolis musician fights for his band's slot at First Avenue while his home life and his love life fall apart.
cue: Serve the cobbler when The Kid dedicates the new song to his father.
faces: “I'd like to dedicate this to my father, Francis L. It's a song the girls in the band wrote, Lisa and Wendy.”
Before he created the music, he lived every bit of it.
Apollonia jumps in to purify herself. Crisp battered fish with tartare.
Morris and Jerome mangle the password. Soft pretzel bites with a hot cheddar dip.
The Time get the club moving. Jerk chicken thighs, rice and peas, charred lime.
Morris tips the waitress then wants it back. Cheese-stuffed Minneapolis beef burgers, pickles.
The song the girls in the band wrote. Blackberry and blueberry cobbler with vanilla cream.
Apollonia 6 debuts at First Avenue. Blackcurrant and lemon topped with sparkling wine.
Billy says your slot is at risk.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing the Kid's monkey puppet at the tables. Card No. 6. Showtime: Serve the cobbler when The Kid dedicates the new song to his father.

Crisp battered fish with tartare.How to make it500g firm white fish fillets, cut in bite-size pieces100g plain flour50g cornflour200ml chilled soda water750ml vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp capers, chopped2 tbsp gherkins, chopped1 lemonStir the mayo with the capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon.Whisk the flours, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a light batter.Dip the fish and fry in oil at 180°C in batches until crisp.Drain, salt and serve with the tartare and lemon wedges.What's-the-password pretzel bitesMorris and Jerome mangle the password. Soft pretzel bites with a hot cheddar dip.How to make it500g ready-made pizza dough2 tbsp bicarbonate of soda1 egg, beaten1 tbsp sea salt flakes20g butter1 tbsp plain flour250ml milk150g sharp cheddar, grated1 tsp hot English mustardRoll the dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites.Drop them in batches into simmering water with the bicarb for 30 seconds, then drain.Brush with egg, sprinkle with salt and bake at 220°C until deep brown.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until thick, then melt in the cheddar and mustard.SupperJungle Love jerk chickenThe Time get the club moving. Jerk chicken thighs, rice and peas, charred lime.How to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets3 tbsp jerk seasoning paste2 tbsp olive oil300g long-grain rice400ml coconut milk400g tin red kidney beans, drained3 spring onions, sliced2 thyme sprigs2 limes, halvedRub the chicken with the jerk paste and oil.Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, beans, spring onions, thyme and 250ml water, covered, until tender.Grill the chicken over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through.Char the lime halves on the grill.Serve the chicken on the rice and peas with the lime.Keep-the-change Jucy Lucy burgersMorris tips the waitress then wants it back. Cheese-stuffed Minneapolis beef burgers, pickles, onions.How to make it800g beef mince8 slices of American cheese4 soft burger buns1 brown onion, finely sliced1/2 cup dill pickle slices4 tbsp American mustardDivide the mince into 8 thin patties.Fold 2 slices of cheese into a square on 4 patties, top with the others and pinch the edges tightly shut.Cook in a hot pan, 5 minutes a side, pricking once so the steam escapes.Serve in buns with onion, pickles and mustard, and warn everyone the cheese is molten.After the ShowPurple Rain blackberry cobblerThe song the girls in the band wrote. Blackberry and blueberry cobbler with vanilla cream.How to make it500g frozen blackberries250g frozen blueberries150g caster sugar1 tbsp cornflour200g self-raising flour80g cold butter, diced150ml buttermilk300ml pouring cream1 tsp vanilla extractToss the berries with 100g of the sugar and the cornflour and tip into a baking dish.Rub the butter into the flour and the rest of the sugar, then stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough.Drop spoonfuls over the fruit and bake at 190°C until golden and bubbling.Stir the vanilla into the cream and pour over to serve.From the BarApollonia 6 blackcurrant sparklerApollonia 6 debuts at First Avenue. Blackcurrant and lemon topped with sparkling wine.How to make it80ml blackcurrant cordial1 lemon750ml bottle sparkling wine12 frozen blueberriesPut 20ml cordial, a squeeze of lemon and 3 frozen blueberries in each of 4 flutes.Top slowly with the sparkling wine.Billy's house bourbonBilly says your slot is at risk.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
